source: BhumiLekh query playbook (283 queries) — 30 screens selected for the v1 Screen Runner

screens.label: Silent accumulator in a cold market
screens.description: A single entity buying repeatedly in a locality where nobody else is transacting.
screens.caveat: Distinguish genuine accumulation from a family partitioning inherited land among heirs.
screens.logic: buyer_entity appears in >=4 registered deeds within a 1km cell over 18 months WHERE cell transaction volume is in the bottom quartile for the district

render.metric: Deeds by one buyer cluster in a cold cell (18m)

screens.label: Power of Attorney cluster
screens.description: Multiple POAs registered to the same holder across different owners in one area.

params.label: Document types
params.help: Instruments counted as a grant to the holder

screens.caveat: Requires the full SRO document index, not just sale deeds.
screens.logic: doc.type IN ('GPA','SPA','agreement_to_sell') GROUP BY holder HAVING distinct_grantors >= 3 within 1km

render.metric: Distinct POA/ATS grantors within 1km

screens.label: First-time buyer cluster
screens.description: A burst of buyers who have never previously transacted anywhere in the district.
screens.caveat: Migration-driven end-user buying looks identical; check parcel sizes — investors buy larger.
screens.logic: COUNT(DISTINCT buyer) WHERE buyer.first_seen_in_district > cell.window_start GROUP BY 1km cell HAVING count >= 5 in 12 months

render.metric: First-time buyers in cell (12m)

screens.label: Newly incorporated SPV buying land
screens.description: Companies incorporated within 12 months of their first land purchase.

params.label: Incorporated within
params.help: Days before the company's first deed

params.label: Only parcels above the district median area

screens.caveat: Also used for benami structuring, which is a different signal — check director profiles.
screens.logic: buyer.type='company' AND (deed.date - company.incorporation_date) < 365 days AND deed.parcel_area > district_median

render.metric: Days from incorporation to first deed

screens.label: Registered agreement-to-sell without a follow-on deed
screens.description: ATS documents registered more than 18 months ago with no corresponding sale deed.
screens.caveat: In some states an unregistered ATS is common practice and carries no signal.
screens.logic: doc.type='agreement_to_sell' AND age > 18 months AND NOT EXISTS(sale_deed on same parcel to same buyer)

columns.label: Age of ATS without sale deed

render.metric: Age of ATS with no follow-on sale deed

screens.label: Buyer paying above circle rate in a flat market
screens.description: Registrations at values materially above the government benchmark where most transact at or below it.
screens.caveat: Sometimes just loan-driven — a buyer needing a high registered value for LTV. Check charge filings.
screens.logic: deed.value_per_sqft / circle_rate > 1.3 AND cell.median_ratio < 1.05

render.metric: Registered ₹/sqft ÷ circle rate

screens.label: Land purchase inside a proposed acquisition corridor
screens.description: Buyers acquiring inside a strip already notified for government acquisition.
screens.caveat: Compensation law and multipliers vary by state and by whether consent provisions apply.
screens.logic: SPATIAL: deed.parcel INTERSECTS acquisition_notification.corridor AND deed.date > notification.date

render.metric: Deeds inside corridor after notification

screens.label: Auction clustering by lender
screens.description: One bank auctioning many properties in a single micro-market simultaneously.
screens.caveat: Also tells you the lender's local book is impaired — useful if you are a lender yourself.
screens.logic: COUNT(auctions) BY lender BY 5km cell WHERE count >= 3 within 6 months

render.metric: Auctions by one lender per 5km cell (6m)

screens.label: Distress-priced land adjacent to healthy development
screens.description: Auctioned parcels sitting immediately next to actively progressing projects.

params.label: Require satellite-confirmed progress
params.help: The caveat asks for genuine progress, not mere registration

screens.caveat: Confirm the neighbouring project is genuinely progressing, not merely registered.
screens.logic: SPATIAL: auction.parcel within 500m of RERA project WITH physical progress confirmed by satellite

render.metric: Distance to a healthy RERA project

screens.label: Auction reserve versus modelled market value
screens.description: Auction listings priced materially below your own comparable-derived valuation.
screens.caveat: Reserve is not the clearing price. Model expected final bid, not reserve.
screens.logic: (model_value - reserve_price) / model_value > 0.25 AND comparable_count >= 5 within 2km and 24 months

render.metric: Discount of reserve vs modelled value

screens.label: Auction inventory ageing by geography
screens.description: Where distressed inventory sits unsold longest.
screens.caveat: Ageing may reflect an inflated reserve rather than weak demand.
screens.logic: MEASURE median days_on_auction by district and asset class

render.metric: Median days on auction, by district

screens.label: Unsold inventory overhang by project
screens.description: Projects sitting on large unsold inventory well past completion.
screens.caveat: Declared inventory is often understated. Cross-check against registered sale deeds in the project.
screens.logic: RERA declared unsold units WHERE project.completion_date < today - 12 months

render.metric: Unsold units >12m after completion

screens.label: Repeated deadline extensions
screens.description: Projects that have sought RERA completion-date extensions more than once.

params.label: Exclude the pandemic-era blanket extension window

screens.caveat: Blanket pandemic-era extensions distort this. Exclude that window.
screens.logic: COUNT(extension applications) per project >= 2

render.metric: Two or more extension applications

screens.label: Developer directorship churn
screens.description: Unusual rates of director appointment and resignation at a developer entity.
screens.caveat: Routine reconstitution after a funding round produces the same pattern.
screens.logic: COUNT(DIR-12 filings) per year vs the developer's own historical rate and peer rate

columns.label: DIR-12 filings per year vs own and peer rate

render.metric: DIR-12 filings per year vs own and peer rate

screens.label: Reservation lapse candidates
screens.description: Reservations that have gone unacquired past the statutory limit and can be released.
screens.caveat: Requires a purchase notice procedure and often litigation. Specialist counsel needed.
screens.logic: reservation.notification_date older than statutory acquisition period AND no acquisition recorded

render.metric: Reservation older than statutory period, not acquired

screens.label: Land use conversion approval base rates
screens.description: Historical approval rate for agricultural-to-non-agricultural conversion, by district.
screens.caveat: Conversion records are public in only some states. Elsewhere use zone adjacency as a proxy.
screens.logic: COUNT(approved CLU) / COUNT(applied CLU) by district and by applicant type

render.metric: CLU approved ÷ applied, by district and applicant

screens.label: Mutation lag detection
screens.description: Registered sales never reflected in the land record.

params.label: Deed older than
params.help: Bhulekh owner still differs from the deed buyer

screens.caveat: Bhulekh update lags are routine. Age the threshold to the state's typical lag.
screens.logic: EXISTS(sale_deed) AND Bhulekh.current_owner ≠ deed.buyer AND deed.age > 24 months

render.metric: Deed buyer ≠ Bhulekh owner after 24m

screens.label: Multiple sale detection
screens.description: The same parcel sold more than once by the same seller to different buyers.
screens.caveat: Sales of undivided shares to different buyers are legitimate and look similar.
screens.logic: GROUP BY parcel: COUNT(deeds) WHERE seller identical AND buyers differ AND periods overlap

render.metric: Same seller, different buyers, overlapping

screens.label: Chain of title completeness
screens.description: Whether every transfer in a parcel's recorded history links to the previous one.
screens.caveat: Records digitised from a cut-off date create artificial gaps before that date.
screens.logic: WALK deed chain backward; flag any gap where seller ≠ prior recorded owner

render.metric: Gap in deed chain (seller ≠ prior owner)

screens.label: Power of attorney sale exposure
screens.description: Sales executed by an attorney rather than the owner.
screens.caveat: Registered irrevocable POAs coupled with consideration are stronger. Check the POA terms.
screens.logic: deed.executant_capacity = 'power of attorney holder'

render.metric: Executant signed as POA holder

screens.label: Land clearing as a pre-construction signal
screens.description: Vegetation removal and ground levelling before any visible structure.
screens.caveat: Agricultural harvest and seasonal fallow produce similar NDVI drops. Require multi-season persistence.
screens.logic: NDVI drop plus bare-soil index increase over a contiguous area > 0.2 hectares

render.metric: Cleared area >0.2ha (NDVI down, bare soil up)

screens.label: Shared registered address clustering
screens.description: Entities sharing a registered office address.
screens.caveat: Chartered accountant offices host hundreds of unrelated entities. Filter known service addresses.
screens.logic: GROUP entities BY normalised registered address HAVING count >= 3

render.metric: Entities per normalised address (≥3)

screens.label: Nominee director identification
screens.description: Individuals holding many directorships with no discernible independent economic profile.
screens.caveat: Some are genuine professional directors. Check tenure and board participation where disclosed.
screens.logic: person.directorship_count > 10 AND no shareholding AND appears across unrelated industries

render.metric: 10+ directorships, no shareholding

screens.label: Seasonality in registration volume
screens.description: Predictable annual cycles in transaction timing.
screens.caveat: Regional festival calendars differ. Compute per region, not nationally.
screens.logic: decompose monthly deed counts into seasonal and trend components per district

render.metric: Seasonal vs trend in monthly deed counts

screens.label: Price-volume divergence
screens.description: Cells where volume is rising but price has not yet moved.
screens.caveat: Can also indicate distressed volume. Cross-check against below-circle-rate share.
screens.logic: volume_growth_yoy > 40th percentile AND price_growth_yoy < 20th percentile

columns.label: Volume growth pct ÷ price growth pct

render.metric: Volume growth high, price growth low

screens.label: Existing partial assemblies
screens.description: Blocks where someone else has already assembled most of the parcels.
screens.caveat: Requires the assembler to still be solvent and committed. Check their entity health.
screens.logic: resolved cluster holds > 60% of a contiguous block area

render.metric: One cluster holds >60% of a contiguous block

screens.label: Parallel assembly detection
screens.description: Two different parties assembling in the same area simultaneously.
screens.caveat: Distinguish genuine competitors from one party using multiple vehicles.
screens.logic: two or more distinct clusters each accumulating in the same 1km cell within the same 18 months

render.metric: Two or more clusters accumulating in one cell

screens.label: Dormant-to-awakening transition
screens.description: Cells showing their first sustained increase in activity after years of nothing.
screens.caveat: Most awakenings stall. Expect a low hit rate and size positions accordingly.
screens.logic: deed velocity and built-up growth both cross above their own 5-year baseline for 3 consecutive quarters

render.metric: Velocity and built-up above 5y baseline for 3Q

screens.label: Conversion candidate with clean title and confirmed access
screens.description: Agricultural land genuinely positioned to convert, with no disqualifying defects.
screens.caveat: Passing every filter still leaves conversion timing uncertain by years.
screens.logic: zone adjacency < 200m AND district CLU approval rate > 50% AND title battery passes AND recorded road access AND not in NDZ/green belt/CRZ

render.metric: Zone-adjacent ∩ CLU rate >50% ∩ title ∩ access ∩ not NDZ

conditions.label: Not in NDZ / green belt / CRZ

screens.label: Quiet accumulation in a dormant cell with confirmed infrastructure
screens.description: The highest-conviction combination available from public data.
screens.caveat: Rare by construction. Expect a handful of hits per state per year.
screens.logic: cluster accumulation detected AND cell lifecycle = dormant/awakening AND infra project has work order AND satellite mobilisation confirmed

render.metric: Accumulation ∩ dormant/awakening ∩ work order ∩ mobilisation
